The interactive map can be accessed by visiting: https://public.tableau.com/app/profile/otec.x.oil.and.gas.gulf.of.america.map/viz/ OTECxOilandGasInterface/Locations The screenshot in Figure 7 shows the landing page of the interface. Figure 7: OTEC and Oil and Gas Co-Location Interactive Map The dots in the larger left hand side portion represent potential locations for consideration. While some locations coincide with existing facilities, and several are future potential facilities, it should be noted that all locations shown are there for hypothetical purposes and were selected due to relevant information, such as water depth and water column temperature, that is available for these locations. However, all outputs for these locations are shown assuming new facility deployment (i.e., there are no examples of retrofitting existing facilities). From this page, the user can make input selections across the top selection bar for locations, intake depth, intake pipe diameter, installation type (add-on or hull-integrated), and refrigerant. The user can also choose what metrics are displayed for the previous 21 OESI 2.0 M-1 T-1-P1.1 – Objective 3 Report April 2025 selections in the table on the right hand side, and finally whether to display the units in metric or imperial. Across the bottom, the output tabs are shown. Locations Map is the default landing page. “GoTo Water Temps” shows the water temperature profile for the selected location. “GoTo Output Power” shows the output power and the process equipment information for the selected location. Finally, “GoTo LCOE Calculator” shows the LCOE and variables comprising it for the selected location and configuration. While the real LCOE is calculated based on assumed default values, additional inputs may be made by the user on this last tab, such as system availability, power transmission distance, operating and maintenance cost factor, interest rate, escalation rate, tax rate, and system life, to allow a sensitivity analysis of the real LCOE calculation using different assumptions. The following subsections discuss the inputs and outputs in further detail. 6.1 Model Inputs Input: Location The locations examined in this study include all 45 existing oil and gas platforms in water depths of greater than 300m. In addition, 14 prospect locations were included. This selection was made in order to narrow down the selection options for locations and to more closely couple the prospective OTEC assessment with oil and gas facilities. The block numbers of the 59 locations are listed in Table 7. In addition to these specific locations, an average water temperature profile across the 59 named locations was determined and included as a “location” in the interactive model.
